forcedChoices.choice: Manotia: «el segundo al mando»; 53:6.3 «segundo comandante»; 53:6.4 «director titular»
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish forces a gender; the masculine follows the grammatical gender of «serafín» and «ángel»; the English gives no gender.

forcedChoices.choice: «los Padres de la Constelación de Norlatiadek»
forcedChoices.reason: The plural Fathers of one constellation; the glossary plural «Padres de las Constelaciones» would imply many constellations.

forcedChoices.choice: «Explotó la reverencia como si fuera ignorancia»
forcedChoices.reason: Keeps both readings of 'traded on reverence as ignorance': he exploited reverence, and he presented it as ignorance.

forcedChoices.choice: «gobierno de los Hijos para el Padre»
forcedChoices.reason: 'for the Father' can mean on behalf of or in service of; «para» keeps both open better than «en nombre del».
ser/estar choice; «ser» states their standing since Pentecost, which the context presents as a lasting condition.
